sources.label: BIG Games - Pet Simulator 99 Nightmare Update

notes: Mega Charm Chest is used only as obtainment context, not as a row.
Coins Charm is the public row name because the source table names the row Coins Charm even though some image labels use Coin Charm.
No live RAP, supply, or value fields are included because those values change constantly.
Gargantuan base slot unlocks are recorded, but public copy avoids an uncertain Overload max for Gargantuan pets.
Images are intentionally blank until clean row icons are localized.

items.name: Bonus Charm
items.effect: Pet has an extra 35% chance for a bonus.
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Bonus Charm is a farming charm for players who want more bonus rolls from a pet they already use often.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Coins Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Coins Charm is the simple coin-farming pick when you care more about area progress or egg costs than diamond drops.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Public row name is Coins Charm; image label may appear as Coin Charm.

items.name: Diamonds Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Diamonds Charm is a direct diamond boost for pets you keep in your main farming team.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Glittering Charm
items.effect: Causes pet to randomly spawn diamonds.
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.slotNote: Stacks with diminishing returns after two Glittering Charms.
items.description: Glittering Charm is for passive diamond drops, but stacking too many copies gives less extra value per slot.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Kept compact diminishing-returns note instead of exact diamond table.

items.name: Treasure Charm
items.effect: Pet increases item drops by 200%, earns 100% more diamonds, and earns 50% more coins.
items.availability: Obtainable from Mega Charm Chest rewards
items.description: Treasure Charm is the strongest mixed farming charm because it boosts item drops, diamonds, and coins at the same time.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Mega Charm Chest retained as source context only.

items.name: Strength Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Strength Charm is the direct damage option for pets you use to clear breakables faster.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Criticals Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Criticals Charm adds random burst damage instead of a flat damage number.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: TNT Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: TNT Charm gives the pet an extra breakable-clearing trigger while it farms.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Lightning Charm
items.effect: Pet randomly lightning strikes nearby breakables.
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Lightning Charm is another triggered breakable effect, aimed at nearby targets instead of pure pet damage.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Agility Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.description: Agility Charm is a movement charm for pets that need to reach breakables faster.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: XP Charm
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
items.slotNote: Pet levels unlock more charm slots on Huge, Titanic, and Gargantuan pets.
items.description: XP Charm helps an eligible pet reach later charm slots sooner.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Effect and rarity match the charm page and items page.

items.name: Royalty Charm
items.effect: Pet deals 40% more damage, earns 20% more diamonds, and moves faster.
items.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, gift bags, and Mega Charm Chest
items.description: Royalty Charm is a broad upgrade for pets where damage, diamond gain, and movement all matter.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Source image labels sometimes misspell Royalty as Royality.

items.name: Overload Charm
items.effect: Adds 2 extra charm slots and can only be used once per pet.
items.obtainment: Adventurer Store, Charm Stone, minigames, chests, gift bags, and Mega Charm Chest
items.availability: Obtainable through gameplay and store routes
items.slotNote: Overload uses one charm slot itself, so it effectively opens one extra usable slot.
items.description: Overload Charm is the slot-planning charm for a pet you expect to keep using long term.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Public copy avoids an uncertain Gargantuan Overload max.

items.name: Charm Stone
items.effect: Break open a Charm Stone to reveal a charm.
items.obtainment: Drops in areas, minigames, and gift bags; can be made by combining multiple charms at the Forge Machine
items.slotNote: Does not equip to a pet; it creates a charm item.
items.description: Charm Stone is the main way players turn gameplay drops into actual charm items.
items.sourcePage: BIG Games Update 1; BIG Games Nightmare Update
items.verificationNote: No stable rarity was published in the checked source lines.

items.name: Charm Hammer
items.effect: Destroys one charm on your pet.
items.obtainment: Random drop from various gift bags
items.slotNote: The removed charm is destroyed permanently.
items.description: Charm Hammer is the risky removal tool because it clears a slot by deleting the attached charm.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Support item included because it controls stable row-level charm removal.

items.name: Charm Chisel
items.effect: Extracts one charm from a pet and adds it back into your inventory.
items.obtainment: Random drop from various gift bags
items.slotNote: The removed charm returns to your inventory.
items.description: Charm Chisel is the safer removal item when you want to keep the charm instead of breaking it.
items.sourcePage: Pet Simulator Wiki charms and items pages
items.verificationNote: Support item included because it controls stable row-level charm recovery.
